notes.title: Infohazard Demo patch 0.8.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes - Version 0.8.1

We've just pushed a shiny new bugfix patch, and boy, do we have some fun updates for you. Check out what's new below:


Fixed an issue with ground detection allowing the player to double-jump. 
Fixed an issue that made it hard to ascend stairs.
Fed Jeffery. 
Removed some debug graphics from the UI that weren't supposed to show. 
Fixed a couple of dialogue lines. 
Added some additional optimizations to the game's screen effects so they run smoother. 
Fixed several menu items that would not function. 
Fixed a bug that prevented quitting the game from the main menu. You can now escape.  Or can you...?
Altered the player's movement speed slightly. 
Fixed several other minor bugs. 


Thanks for your continued support and feedback! Keep exploring, keep surviving, and don't forget to feed Jeffery!

notes.title: Infohazard Demo Update!
notes.content:
Exciting Update!

Dive deeper into the eerie world of Infohazard with our latest demo update! Experience nearly the entire first chapter, from the haunting grounds of SCP-3930 to the mysterious depths of Site-97's underbelly.

🔥 What's New?


 Expanded exploration: uncover new secrets and reality-bending encounters.
 More environments and Foundation secrets to immerse yourself in
 Collectibles

We'll be rolling out more updates in the coming weeks, so keep an eye out for the latest enhancements!

📢 Join the Fun!
Stream your gameplay and reactions on social media! Share your feedback in our discussion forums!
